headlines.summary_en: [Purui Digital Ding Zuyu: H1 home price decline slowing, housing market 'bottom confirmation underway'] "In H1 2026, the property market is not simply entering a phase of total volume recovery, but rather a phase of structural optimization," said Ding Zuyu, chairman of Purui Digital, in a keynote speech titled "H1 2026 Property Market Review and H2 Outlook." headlines.title: 刘海星率中共代表团访问古巴并出席首届“菲德尔国际对话”
headlines.summary: 8月8日至10日，中共中央对外联络部部长刘海星率中共代表团访问古巴并出席首届“菲德尔国际对话”。其间，同古共中央第一书记、古巴国家主席迪亚斯-卡内尔，古共中央政治局委员、中央组织书记莫拉莱斯，古共中央国际关系部部长洛萨达等会见交流。双方表示，将共同落实好两党两国最高领导人达成的重要共识，赓续传统友谊，深化党际交往，加强战略沟通与协作，携手推进各自国家社会主义事业，为中古命运共同体建设作出更大贡献。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Liu Haixing Leads CPC Delegation to Cuba, Attends First 'Fidel International Dialogue'
headlines.summary_en: From August 8 to 10, Liu Haixing, head of the International Department of the CPC Central Committee, led a CPC delegation to visit Cuba and attend the first "Fidel International Dialogue." During the visit, they met and exchanged views with Cuba's First Secretary of the Communist Party and President, Diaz-Canel, Politburo member and Secretary for Organization Morales, and International Relations Secretary Lozada. Both sides expressed commitment to implementing the important consensus of the two party and state leaders, continuing traditional friendship, deepening inter-party exchanges, strengthening strategic communication and coordination, jointly advancing socialist causes in their respective countries, and making greater contributions to the China-Cuba community with a shared future. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 综合多重因素，赴港投保性价比被重新评估
headlines.summary: 近日调研获悉，受“香港保单收益征税”消息影响，一些消费者正重新评估赴港投保性价比。已有多位香港保险营销员接到客户咨询，他们明显感受到市场正在降温。此外，随着人民币汇率不断升值，赴港投保的预期收益有所降低。在业内人士看来，受税收、汇率等因素影响，短期内消费者赴港投保将会降温，尤其是投资型保险产品受影响更大。对于消费者而言，未来赴港投保应综合考虑产品、汇率、合规、服务等多方面因素。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Multiple Factors Lead to Reassessment of Hong Kong Insurance Value Proposition
headlines.summary_en: Recent research indicates that affected by the news of "Hong Kong policy income taxation," some consumers are reassessing the cost-effectiveness of purchasing insurance in Hong Kong. Multiple Hong Kong insurance agents have received client inquiries, and they clearly feel the market is cooling. Additionally, as the RMB appreciates, expected returns from Hong Kong insurance policies have declined. Industry insiders believe that due to factors such as taxation and exchange rates, consumer demand for Hong Kong insurance will cool in the short term, especially for investment-type products. For consumers, future purchases should consider factors such as product, exchange rate, compliance, and service comprehensively. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: China's MOFCOM: Beef Imports from Brazil Reached 90% of Safeguard Measure Threshold
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce announced that as of August 10, 2026, beef imports from Brazil under the beef safeguard measure had reached 90% of the specified quantity for that country (region) as set out in MOFCOM Announcement No. 87 of 2025. According to MOFCOM Announcement No. 87 of 2025, from the 3rd day after imports reach 100% of the specified quantity (inclusive), an additional 55% tariff will be imposed on top of the current applicable tariff rate.

headlines.title: Hong Kong’s commercial property investment growth beats peer Asia-Pacific markets
headlines.summary:
Hong Kong’s commercial property investment more than doubled to US$3.1 billion in the second quarter, making it the fastest growing investment market in Asia-Pacific thanks to a strong increase in retail and office deals and a low base effect, according to JLL.

headlines.summary_zh: 据仲量联行数据，香港商业地产投资在第二季度增长超过一倍，达到31亿美元，成为亚太地区增长最快的投资市场，这得益于零售和写字楼交易的大幅增加以及基数效应较低。同比增长129%，超过了新加坡等其他表现最佳的市场。

headlines.title_zh: 在疲弱的香港零售物业市场中，麦当劳的资产有何独特之处？
headlines.summary_zh: 麦当劳开始出售其自有的香港门店一年后，这家快餐巨头已为其近半数的资产组合找到了买家，尽管香港零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。据市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段处置全部23家门店，该资产组合初始估值约为30亿港元（合3美元）。

headlines.title: 金融产品网络营销新规9月底起实施，保险业提前摸排整治账号端乱象
headlines.summary: 金融产品网络营销最严监管规定——《金融产品网络营销管理办法》将于9月30日起实施。记者从相关渠道获悉，针对办法对保险机构网络营销划定的“硬杠杠”，监管部门正在主动摸排整治账号端乱象、厘清市场生态，为新规落地铺路。受访人士表示，随着监管部门整治深入和办法落地实施，“机构担责+人证合一+可回溯”将是保险网络营销的最终走向。从长期看，这有利于降低消费者的信任成本，激活真实保险需求，推动保险机构业务质量、续保率等长期指标提升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: New Financial Product Online Marketing Rules Effective End of September, Insurance Industry Preemptively Rectifies Account Chaos
headlines.summary_en: The strictest regulatory rules for online marketing of financial products—the "Measures for the Management of Online Marketing of Financial Products"—will take effect on September 30. Reporters learned from relevant channels that regulators are proactively investigating and rectifying account-related irregularities and clarifying the market landscape to pave the way for the new rules. Interviewees said that as regulatory inspections deepen and the measures take effect, "institutional accountability + person-certificate matching + traceability" will be the ultimate direction for insurance online marketing. In the long run, this helps lower consumer trust costs, activate real insurance demand, and drive improvements in long-term metrics such as business quality and renewal rates for insurers. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 高塔姆·阿达尼赢得美国证券欺诈指控的驳回
headlines.summary: 美国纽约东区联邦地区法院法官Nicholas Garaufis驳回了对高塔姆·阿达尼及其侄子萨加尔·阿达尼的共谋、证券欺诈和电信欺诈指控。 美国方面指控阿达尼参与了一项向印度政府官员行贿超过2.5亿美元以锁定太阳能合同的计划——阿达尼始终否认这些指控。 该裁决标志着阿达尼在美国法律麻烦的终结，此前他还曾与美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和财政部达成和解。

headlines.title_en: Gautam Adani Wins Dismissal of US Securities Fraud Charges
headlines.summary_en: U.S. District Judge Nicholas Garaufis in the Eastern District of New York dismissed conspiracy, securities fraud, and wire fraud charges against Gautam Adani and his nephew Sagar Adani. U.S. authorities had accused Adani of participating in a scheme to bribe Indian government officials over $250 million to secure solar contracts—charges Adani consistently denied. The ruling marks the end of Adani's U.S. legal troubles, following earlier settlements with the SEC and the Treasury Department.
